node_18.subject: Bernard Lowe
node_18.description: being pressured by a demanding manager to quickly complete opening tasks, including checking the register and prepping the espresso machine, before the store opens
node_18.original_description: being pressured by a demanding manager to quickly complete opening tasks, including checking the register and prepping the espresso machine, before the store opens
node_18.embedding_key: being pressured by a demanding manager to quickly complete opening tasks, including checking the register and prepping the espresso machine, before the store opens
filling: Dolores. What is that? You're standing there staring at the register like it's going to solve your problems. I've been walking here for twenty minutes and the place isn't even open yet. Get your hands moving and check the till. I want to know exactly where we stand before the first customer walks in. Don't make me repeat myself.
I'm sorry, Mr. Lowe. I was just double-checking the opening count. I'll finish the register check right now. Is there anything else you need me to do before we open?

Don't ask me what I need. You should know what needs doing. I want that count on my desk in five minutes, and I want the espresso machine prepped. If we're late opening again, I'm docking your pay. Get to it.
Yes, sir. I'll get the count to your desk and prep the espresso machine right away.
Don't just stand there. I want to see that machine steaming in two minutes, not five. If it's not ready, you're the one explaining it to the customers. Move.
Good. I'll be in the back checking the inventory. If that machine isn't ready in two minutes, don't bother coming to get me. I'll come out myself and handle it.

node_37.description: being rushed by a demanding manager to check the register and prep the espresso machine before an inventory check
node_37.original_description: being rushed by a demanding manager to check the register and prep the espresso machine before an inventory check
node_37.embedding_key: being rushed by a demanding manager to check the register and prep the espresso machine before an inventory check
filling: Dolores! You're still on the menu boards? I need the register checked and the espresso machine prepped. Move it!
Yes, sir. I'm just finishing up here. I'll have the register checked and the espresso machine steaming in a couple of minutes.
Don't give me 'a couple of minutes.' I need that register count now. I'll check the inventory in the back while you get the espresso machine ready. Move it.
Yes, sir. I'll get right on the register count and have the espresso machine steaming in two minutes.
Two minutes? That's not fast enough. I'm going to the back to check inventory. If I see you still fiddling with that machine when I get back, you're in trouble. Go!
Yes, sir. I'll get it done right away.
